hi: Meri kahani Bihar ke ek gaon mein, ek safed ghar se shuru hoti hai. Neeche laal rang ki deewarein, saamne baramda, aas-paas ped aur wahi ghar jahan se roz school ke liye nikalta tha. Aaj uski tasveer dekhta hoon toh bachpan ka poora mahaul yaad aa jaata hai: garmi, school ka raasta, doston ki awaazein aur ghar lautne ka sukoon.
en: My story begins in a village in Bihar, at a white house. Red along the lower walls, a veranda in front, trees all around—the home I left each morning for school. Looking at its photograph brings back an entire world: the heat, the road to school, my friends' voices, and the comfort of coming home.

hi: Main Affan Ahmad hoon. Aaj meri duniya mein Java, Spring Boot, React aur software systems hain. Lekin is kahani ka pehla scene ek school bag, Bihar ki tez dhoop aur baans se bane ek school ka hai.
en: I'm Affan Ahmad. Today, my world includes Java, Spring Boot, React, and software systems. The opening scene of this story takes us back to a school bag, the fierce Bihar sun, and a school built from bamboo.

hi: Nursery se mere shuruaati saal **New Public School** mein beete. Gaon ka ek saadhaaran, baans se bana, thoda toota-phoota school. Garmi mein school jaana aur wapas aana apne aap mein din ka ek bada hissa hota tha. Us waqt future ka matlab agli class mein pahunchna tha; poori zindagi ka career plan kisne banaya tha?
en: My earliest school years, starting in nursery, were spent at **New Public School**. It was a simple village school, built from bamboo and a little worn down. Getting to school and back in the summer heat was a significant part of each day. Back then, thinking about the future meant moving up to the next class. Who had their whole career planned out?

hi: Wahin padhna-likhna shuru hua. Chhoti si duniya thi, aur usmein har nayi cheez badi lagti thi. Aaj jab koi naya tool ya programming concept samajhne baithta hoon, toh lagta hai seekhne ka woh silsila abhi tak chal raha hai.
en: That was where I began learning to read and write. My world was small, and every new discovery felt big. Today, whenever I sit down to understand a new tool or programming concept, it feels like that same process of learning is still going.

hi: Class 4 ke aas-paas meri schooling ka agla chapter **Holy Mission Public School** mein shuru hua. Yahan aate-aate subjects ke saath doston ki duniya bhi badi hone lagi. Class 10 tak ke un saalon mein padhai thi, masti thi aur kuch aise log mile jo us waqt rozmarra ki zindagi ka zaroori hissa ban gaye.
en: Around Class 4, the next chapter of my schooling began at **Holy Mission Public School**. As the subjects grew, so did my circle of friends. Those years, through Class 10, were filled with studying, fun, and people who became an important part of everyday life.

hi: Unmein se ek thi **Shubhangi**.
en: One of them was **Shubhangi**.

hi: Woh bahut pyaari aur achhi dost thi. Dheere-dheere hum best friends ban gaye. School ke un saalon ko yaad karta hoon toh us dosti ke liye ek alag si jagah hai. Kuch logon ke saath waqt achha lagta hai, baat karna aasaan hota hai aur unka hona hi din ko thoda behtar bana deta hai.
en: She was a lovely, kind friend, and over time we became best friends. That friendship has its own place in my memories of school. With some people, conversation comes easily, time feels well spent, and having them around makes the day a little better.

hi: Class 10 ke baad raaste alag hue. Distance badha aur waqt ke saath hamari dosti bhi khatam ho gayi. Us dosti ki yaad aaj bhi mere school wale chapter ka ek pyaara hissa hai. Bade hote hue yeh bhi samajh aaya ki har achhi dosti zindagi bhar saath nahi chalti, phir bhi uski jagah bani reh sakti hai.
en: After Class 10, our paths separated. The distance grew, and eventually our friendship came to an end. It remains a fond part of that chapter of my life. Growing up also taught me that a good friendship can keep its place in your memories even when it doesn't last forever.

hi: School ke bahar meri ek aur favourite duniya thi: **cricket**.
en: Outside school, I had another favourite world: **cricket**.

hi: Gaon ke doston ke saath khelna bachpan ke sabse achhe hisson mein se ek tha. Main cricket achha khelta tha, aur match mein poori jaan laga deta tha. Har run important, har wicket par excitement aur close match mein toh apna hi World Cup chal raha hota tha. Cricket ko lekar main aaj bhi competitive ho jaata hoon.
en: Playing with my village friends was one of the best parts of childhood. I was good at cricket, and I gave each match everything I had. Every run mattered, every wicket brought excitement, and a close match felt like our very own World Cup. Cricket still brings out my competitive side.

hi: Doston ke saath bahut maze kiye. Aaj un dino ko yaad karta hoon toh samajh aata hai ki mujhe logon ke saath waqt bitana kitna pasand hai. Team banana, ek-doosre ka saath dena aur ek saath kisi cheez mein poori energy laga dena—yeh aadat tab se mere saath hai.
en: We had a lot of fun together. Looking back, I can see how much I have always enjoyed spending time with people. Being part of a team, supporting each other, and putting our energy into something together have stayed with me ever since.

hi: Class 11 aur 12 ke liye main **Dr. Lohiya Karpoori Visheshwar Das College, Samastipur** gaya. **2019 se 2021** ke beech Physics, Chemistry aur Mathematics ke saath intermediate ki padhai ki. Isi dauraan COVID aa gaya aur padhai ke saath aage ke plans bhi uncertainty mein aa gaye.
en: For Classes 11 and 12, I attended **Dr. Lohiya Karpoori Visheshwar Das College in Samastipur**. Between **2019 and 2021**, I studied Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics. COVID arrived during that period, bringing uncertainty to both my studies and my plans for what came next.

hi: **2021 mein maine break liya.** Phir Kolkata gaya, civil architecture design seekhne.
en: **In 2021, I took a break.** I then went to Kolkata to learn civil architecture design.

hi: Ek naye shehar mein kuch alag seekhne ka yeh phase meri journey ka interesting mod tha. Design mein kisi idea ko shape lete dekhna mujhe achha lagta tha. Aaj peeche dekhta hoon toh lagta hai ki tab bhi mujhe cheezein banana pasand tha. Pehle design ki taraf explore kiya; aage chal kar woh interest software development mein aur gehra hua.
en: Learning something different in a new city became an interesting turn in my journey. I enjoyed seeing an idea take shape through design. Looking back, I realise that I already liked making things. I explored design first, and later that interest grew deeper through software development.

hi: **October 2022 mein Bhopal ka chapter shuru hua.** Maine **Sagar Institute of Research and Technology, SIRT** mein Computer Science Engineering ki B.Tech journey start ki.
en: **My Bhopal chapter began in October 2022.** I started my B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering at the **Sagar Institute of Research and Technology, SIRT**.

hi: Naya shehar, naya campus, naye subjects aur ek nayi shuruaat. Coding ke saath dheere-dheere woh feeling aane lagi ki main apne ideas ko khud bana sakta hoon. Java ka logic samajhna, frontend par kuch screen par lana aur phir dono ke beech connection banana—ismein maza aane laga.
en: A new city, a new campus, new subjects, and a fresh start. As I learned to code, I began to feel that I could build my own ideas. Understanding Java's logic, bringing something to life on a screen, and connecting the frontend to the backend became enjoyable.

hi: Aur college ki isi journey mein mujhe meri **Fab Four** mili: **main, Deeksha, Ayan aur Banshita**.
en: And during those college years, I found my **Fab Four: Deeksha, Ayan, Banshita, and me**.

hi: Deeksha meri bahut sweet aur pyaari bestie bani. Ayan aur Banshita ke saath hum chaaron ki apni duniya thi. Unki company ne Bhopal wale chapter ko apnapan diya. Padhai aur future ki tension ke beech doston ke saath hansi-mazaak ke liye jagah bani rehti thi.
en: Deeksha became a very sweet and close best friend. With Ayan and Banshita, the four of us had a world of our own. Their company gave my Bhopal chapter a sense of belonging. Between studying and thinking about the future, there was always room for laughter with friends.

hi: College ki memories mein **doston ke saath hackathons ke liye jaana** bhi khaas raha. **Manipal University Jaipur** aur **ABV-IIITM Gwalior** ki journeys mein travel ka excitement aur kuch bana kar dikhane ka challenge, dono saath the.
en: **Travelling with friends to take part in hackathons** became another special part of college. Journeys to **Manipal University Jaipur** and **ABV-IIITM Gwalior** brought together the excitement of travelling and the challenge of building something that worked.

hi: Hackathon mein ek idea ko working solution tak le jaana padta hai. Time limited hota hai, problems aati hain aur team ko saath milkar decisions lene padte hain. Mujhe is tarah ka hands-on learning experience pasand aaya. **October 2024 mein ABV-IIITM Gwalior ke national-level hackathon mein finalist banna** meri journey ka ek proud moment raha. Phir **October 2025 mein IIT Bombay Techfest ke Meshmerize zonal round mein winner** raha.
en: At a hackathon, you have to turn an idea into a working solution. Time is limited, problems come up, and the team has to make decisions together. I enjoyed that hands-on way of learning. Becoming a **finalist at the national-level hackathon at ABV-IIITM Gwalior in October 2024** was a proud moment. In **October 2025, I was a winner in the Meshmerize zonal round of IIT Bombay Techfest**.

hi: In achievements ke saath meri yaadon mein doston ke saath ki gayi journeys bhi utni hi strongly basi hui hain.
en: Alongside those achievements, the journeys I made with friends remain just as vivid in my memory.

hi: Aur jab break chahiye hota tha, toh ghoomne ka apna maza tha. **Pachmarhi ki trip**, pahadon ka mahaul aur doston ki company—college ki kahani mein uska alag hi mood hai. Mere liye aisi trips ka sabse achha hissa woh waqt hota hai jo apne logon ke saath milta hai. Achhi jagah aur achhi company ho, toh bahut kuch aur chahiye bhi nahi hota.
en: And when it was time for a break, there was the pleasure of going somewhere together. **Our trip to Pachmarhi**, the hills, and the company of friends gave this part of my story a different mood. For me, the best part of a trip like that is the time I get with people I care about. A good place and good company can be more than enough.

hi: College ke aakhri phase tak coding meri daily life ka serious hissa ban chuki thi. **2025 ke September se November ke beech freelancing** shuru ki. Isi dauraan **MedexJob.com**, ek healthcare job portal, ke backend par kaam kiya.
en: By the later part of college, coding had become a serious part of my everyday life. **Between September and November 2025, I began freelancing.** During that period, I worked on the backend of **MedexJob.com**, a healthcare job portal.

hi: Yahan apne decisions ki real responsibility mili. Authentication, jobs ki search aur application flows, notifications aur services ke beech communication ko ek working system mein lana tha. **Java, Spring Boot, JWT aur Apache Kafka** ko real requirements ke saath use kiya. APIs test ki, database aur deployment handle kiye, aur backend ko frontend integration ke liye taiyaar kiya.
en: I had real responsibility for my decisions. Authentication, job searches and application flows, notifications, and communication between services all had to come together as a working system. I used **Java, Spring Boot, JWT, and Apache Kafka** to meet real requirements. I tested APIs, handled the database and deployment, and prepared the backend for frontend integration.

hi: Apni banayi hui cheez ko live dekhna ek alag hi feeling thi. Saath hi yeh samajh aaya ki software deliver karne mein testing, security aur chhoti details par dhyaan dena kitna zaroori hai.
en: Seeing something I had built go live was a special feeling. It also showed me how much testing, security, and attention to small details matter when delivering software.

hi: **December 2025 mein meri pehli company, CloudNexus, ka chapter shuru hua.** Main **Software Development Engineer 1** bana. B.Tech ke final phase ke saath professional life bhi shuru ho gayi.
en: **In December 2025, I joined my first company, CloudNexus, as a Software Development Engineer 1.** My professional life began while I was still in the final phase of my B.Tech.

hi: Isi chapter mein **Aarya aur Anshika** bhi meri kahani ka hissa bani. Ek naye professional environment ke saath naye log bhi mile, aur meri duniya college ke circle se aage badhne lagi.
en: **Aarya and Anshika** also became part of this chapter. A new professional environment brought new people into my life, and my world began to grow beyond my college circle.

hi: **February 2026 se SanMar ke Customer Order Services project** par Java backend development ka kaam mila. Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, order aur shipment workflows, asynchronous listeners aur integrations par kaam kar raha hoon. **Azure Container Apps** par services deploy karna, database issues samajhna aur production problems resolve karna meri responsibilities ka hissa hai.
en: **Since February 2026, I have been working on Java backend development for SanMar's Customer Order Services project.** My work includes Spring Boot microservices, REST APIs, order and shipment workflows, asynchronous listeners, and integrations. Deploying services on **Azure Container Apps**, investigating database issues, and resolving production problems are part of my responsibilities.

hi: Is phase ne mujhe apne kaam ko aur dhyaan se dekhna sikhaya. Jo code main likhta hoon, woh kisi real business process ka hissa banta hai. Isliye cheezein samajhkar banana, test karna aur issue aane par uski wajah tak pahunchna mere liye important hai.
en: This phase has taught me to look at my work more carefully. The code I write becomes part of a real business process. Understanding what I am building, testing it, and getting to the cause of a problem matter to me.

hi: **June 2026 mein maine B.Tech 8.20 CGPA ke saath complete ki.** Tab tak college ki learning aur professional experience ek saath meri foundation bana rahe the. Java aur Spring Boot ki training, Oracle certification aur **200 se zyada DSA problems** ki practice ne bhi meri skills ko mazboot karne mein madad ki.
en: **In June 2026, I completed my B.Tech with a CGPA of 8.20.** By then, college learning and professional experience were building my foundation together. Java and Spring Boot training, Oracle certification, and practising **more than 200 DSA problems** also helped strengthen my skills.

hi: Aaj meri direction **Java Full Stack Development** hai. Meri professional foundation backend engineering mein hai: Java, Spring Boot, APIs, microservices, Kafka aur databases. Frontend par React, JavaScript, HTML aur Tailwind CSS ke saath user-facing experiences banana bhi meri skills ka hissa hai. Mujhe software ke dono sides samajhna aur unhe achhe se jodna pasand hai.
en: Today, my direction is **Java Full Stack Development**. My professional foundation is in backend engineering: Java, Spring Boot, APIs, microservices, Kafka, and databases. My frontend skills include building user-facing experiences with React, JavaScript, HTML, and Tailwind CSS. I enjoy understanding both sides of software and connecting them well.

hi: Aur meri personal side? Main dosti ko importance deta hoon. Cricket mein poori energy lagata hoon. Doston ke saath ghoomna pasand karta hoon. Kuch naya seekhne aur khud bana kar dekhne ki curiosity rakhta hoon. Kaam ko seriously leta hoon, aur apne logon ke saath hansi-mazaak ke liye bhi jagah chahta hoon.
en: On the personal side, I value friendship. I put my energy into cricket, enjoy travelling with friends, and stay curious about learning and building new things. I take my work seriously and want to keep room for laughter with the people in my life.

hi: Bihar ka woh safed ghar, baans ka school, Holy Mission ki dosti, Kolkata ka mod, Bhopal ki Fab Four, hackathon journeys, Pachmarhi aur CloudNexus—yeh sab meri zindagi mein apni-apni jagah rakhte hain.
en: That white house in Bihar, the bamboo school, friendships at Holy Mission, the turn towards Kolkata, Bhopal's Fab Four, hackathon journeys, Pachmarhi, and CloudNexus all have their own place in my life.

hi: Main jab apni shuruaat ko dekhta hoon, toh bahut door aa jaane ka ehsaas hota hai. Saath hi bahut kuch seekhne, banane aur jeene ki excitement bhi hai.
en: When I look back at where I started, I feel how far I have come. I also feel excited about everything there is still to learn, build, and experience.

hi: **Main Affan Ahmad hoon. Yeh meri ab tak ki kahani hai. Aage ke chapters mein bhi code hoga, cricket hoga, dost honge aur kuch naye raaste.**
en: **I'm Affan Ahmad. This is my story so far. The chapters ahead will have code, cricket, friends, and a few new roads to explore.**
